caption: The drawing depicts a seated figure resembling a doll or mannequin with a pale, round face, blonde or light brown hair, and pinkish cheeks. The doll is dressed in a long, full, black dress that covers its entire body down to the shoes, and the dress features lace trim in white at the collar, cuffs, and hem. The upper part of the dress is detailed with black decorative elements and ruffles, and the doll wears a small belt at the waist. The doll is holding a thin wire or string in both hands, with one hand also holding a small red rectangular object at its waist. The doll's shoes are black, and the lower hem of the dress is decorated with additional white lace. The figure's eyes are dark and round, and the lips are red. The background is plain off-white with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Doll
